feature: P5-TB-MIX mixed-format HWPX textbox range deletion and paragraph join
supported: Top-level, uncaptioned HWPX body text boxes with no more than 64 non-empty paragraphs whose text topology is fully observable. Delete may join ordinary paragraphs with different paragraph-shape/style references. The joined paragraph retains the starting paragraph identity, paraPrIDRef and styleIDRef; retained prefix/suffix character runs keep their source character formatting. The edit is one Undo/Redo transaction.
refused: HWP5; captioned or grouped text boxes; more than 64 paragraphs; empty text; page/column or unobservable raw break structure; controls, field/range/title/markpen markers, extended tabs, tab characters, HWPX text topology or numbering restart. Replacement is separately supported only under the documented P5-TB-REPLACE HWPX IME/plain-text and HWP5 collapsed-caret paste contract; other unsupported topology fails before mutation.
